title: Mach 5.35 flat-plate second-mode LST neutral-curve benchmark
benchmark_scope: Dimensional second-mode neutral envelope used for the DNS-DSMC particulate collaboration case.

flow_conditions.wall_thermal_condition: adiabatic-wall approximation used in the Mach 5.35 particulate study
flow_conditions.unit_reynolds_note: The 2025 LST conversion scripts and analysis writeup use 11.76e6 1/m with U_edge = 857 m/s. The newer DSMC consistency check and AviationAbstract2 condition table report 1.1935e7 1/m from Prot0.dat. Both values are recorded because the imported curve is from the 2025 LST reference path.

curve_data.interpretation: At each frequency, x_left and x_right are the two streamwise neutral-branch locations; the unstable band lies between them where both branches exist.

notes: The raw Tecplot-style file is preserved exactly as supplied.
The CSV is a unit-normalized convenience copy for automated pyMack benchmark comparison.
This benchmark records the external LST neutral curve used by the Mach 5.35 particulate study; it is not a pyMack-generated solution.
